authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3848 khalla lists Prakrit khallā “leather”, Bihari/Hindi khāl “hide/skin” and regional khāl. Rana khal fits this skin family, whose deeper origin and relation to challi remain uncertain. Joint comparison: kaithal kʰal “skin” matches reviewed Rana kʰal “skin” (f_6e644z5evuf3y). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
